dedupe_keys.name: global dataset of projected impacts of climate change on four major crops 8 703 simulations

description: A compilation of published crop model projections of climate change impacts on yields. The Scientific Data paper (16 February 2022) says the dataset consolidates earlier meta-analyses and a new literature search into 8,703 simulations from 202 studies published between 1984 and 2020, with projected yields of maize, rice, soybean and wheat in 91 countries under major emission scenarios for the 21st century, with and without adaptation, plus coordinates, current temperature and precipitation and projected changes. The data are a free download on figshare, and the paper is under CC BY. Coverage is 91 countries. Caveats: studies differ in models and assumptions, so the dataset suits meta-analysis, not local forecasts. For simulation it gives expected yield changes by warming level to feed long-term food supply and farm income scenarios. A related catalogue record is the ISIMIP repository.
